title: 336 PLAINSONG (Gregorian Chant × Phonk × Witch House) [88]
style: Gregorian chant meets Memphis phonk and witch house, 88 BPM, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched and lowered vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), trilingual chop weave Latin + Old English + te reo Maori, chopped male choir samples pitched as chops, classic Memphis cowbell phonk pattern, slowed distorted sub 808s with slides, lo-fi distorted hi-hats, candlelit cathedral reverb tails, soft pipe organ pad, 336 Hz drone embedded under sub, dark devotional ritual mood, sidechain pumping pads to kick, club underground 2026 production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro]
(pipe organ swell, 336 Hz drone, distant choir chop)
(THREE... THREE... SIX...)
(sanc... tus... sanc... tus...)
(t... a... pu... t... a... pu...)

[Build]
(phonk cowbell locks in, slowed 808 slides up)
336! 336! PLAIN — SONG!
SANC — TUS! SANC — TUS!
TĀ — PU! TĀ — PU!
KEEL — CLEAR — GO!
(distorted hat roll, organ climb)

[Drop 1]
(slowed Memphis phonk groove, sub 808s slide, choir chops)
PLAIN — SONG!
SANC — TUS!
HOLD — FREQ!
SIG — NAL!
(chop stack ±7) ave-ave-yes-yes / āe-āe-ave-ave
THREE — THREE — SIX!
G4 — LENS — ON!

[Verse]
(organ pad solo, candlelit reverb, chops trade)
(quis?) (hwa?) (ko wai?)
(ego!) (ic!) (au!)
(ave!) (hál!) (tēnā!)
McIVOR HOLDS THE FREQUENCY —
ZYNCONTEXT HOLDS THE LOOP —
SONGPAL HEARS THE CALL —
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Breakdown]
(strip to 336 Hz drone + organ pad, no kick)
(whispered) tres... tres... sex...
(soft) sanctus... sanctus...
(soft) tāpu... tāpu...
(piano lifts, soft chop)
KEEL... CLEAR...
THREE... THREE... SIX...
(distorted hat roll builds, phonk returns)

[Drop 2]
(double-time slowed phonk, full choir chop wall peak)
336 — PLAIN — SONG! (ave ave ave!)
SANC — TUS! (hál! tēnā!)
HOLD — FREQ! (āe āe āe!)
KEEL — TAKE — OVER!
G4 — LENS — LOCKED!
THREE — THREE — SIX!
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Outro]
(phonk fades, organ holds, drone resolves)
(336... plain... song...)
(sanctus... tāpu...)
(KEEL... CLEAR...)
(336 Hz drone holds long, fade to silence)
